title: Princess Charming and Her Trusty... Steed?

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The Tower of Luna, a mysterious structure
said to contain hints regarding {0}'s memories.
A certain group has come to investigate.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}の記憶の手掛かりが
あるとされている、天高くそびえるルナの塔に
ある一団の姿があった。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
So this here is the Tower of Luna.
What a mighty strange place.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここが
ルナの塔どすかぁ。
えらい難義そうなところやなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
H-hey...
I dunno why you brought me here. 
Where are we?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね、
ねぇ……？
ワケも分からないまま連れてこられちゃったけど、
ここはどこなの？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
This here's the Tower of Luna.
We're lookin' for clues on how to get the prince's memories back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここはルナの塔いうて、
王子はんの記憶を
取り戻す手がかりがあるところなんやて。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
Are we?
If that's the case, you should've told me, and I would have come of my own accord!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなの？
それならそう言ってくれれば
普通について来たのに～！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Didn't I tell ya?
text_block_list.orig_text: 言いまへんでしたやろか？

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
No, you didn't!
You suddenly said, \"I want you to be the Maho-Maho Kingdom's
white horse,\" and just dragged me here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
言わなかったわよ！
いきなり、
マホマホ王国の白馬になって欲しい、
とか言われて
連れてこられたんでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
I beg your pardon.
I guess you're such a darn perfect sweet li'l white horse,
I plumb forgot to explain what I was up to.
choice_data_list: You two don't know each other?
text_block_list.orig_text:
かんにんなぁ。
リマはんが
あんまり理想の
かいらしい白馬はんやったさかい、
説明するのを
忘れてしもたんやろなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
I'd heard about Maho from Rin and Shiori,
who are on transfer from Caon... but this is our first time meeting, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
リンちゃんとシオリちゃんが
【自警団（カォン）】から出向してるから、
マホちゃんのことは知っていたけど……
会うのは初めてよね？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
I'd heard all about Lima too, but actually makin' her acquaintance?
This is the first time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そやなぁ。
うちも
リマはんのことは聞いてましたけど、
実際に会うんは
これが
初めてやなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
I never thought I'd be treated like a horse out of the blue on a first
encounter... though I am used to being treated like a monster.
text_block_list.orig_text:
初対面で
いきなり馬扱いされるとは思わなかったわ……
魔物扱いなら慣れてるけど……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Monster?
Ain't no way I'd say such a thing 'bout a lovely li'l white horse!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物やなんて。
かいらしい白馬はんを、
そない言うわけ
ありまへん！

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
L-lovely? Thank you... Wait, huh?!
I'm not a horse!
text_block_list.orig_text:
か、
かいらしい？　
ありがとう……
って！
結局は馬じゃないの！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Truly... You're the ideal white horse...
So lovely...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
ほんま……
リマはんは
理想の白馬はんやわぁ……
かいらしなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Don't pet me with such a euphoric look on your face!
Even if it does feel good!
H-hey, {0}! Please make her stop!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわ！
そんな
うっとりした顔でなでなでしないで！　
気持ちいいけど！
ちょ、
ちょっと{0}くん！　
止めてちょうだ～い！

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I didn't say you could join in!
Ah, but I guess maybe it does feel a biiit nice!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたまで一緒になでなでしないでよ～！
あ、
でもいい感じかも～！！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You're really likin' her fur, aren't you, my prince?
I'm getting a li'l jealous.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
王子はんも
この毛並みに夢中やね。
少し妬けてしまうわ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
What's this? You want me to give you a good stroke too?
If that's the case, scooch on over here.
Pet pet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたん？　
王子はんも
なでなでしてほしいん？
ほんなら
こっちに来たらよろしおす。
なでなで～

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: Why is she petting you too?!
text_block_list.orig_text: どうしてあなたも一緒になでられてるのよ～！？

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
A-anyway!
Inside this tower there are clues about getting
{0}'s memories back, right?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
と、
ともかく！
この塔の中に
{0}くんの記憶を取り戻す
手がかりがあるのよね！？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: I reckon that's right.
text_block_list.orig_text: そうらしいどすなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
Then the three of us should climb it together!
That way we'll find the clues more easily!
I'll give it my all! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
なら、
３人で一緒に登りましょう！
そのほうが手がかりも見つけやすいでしょう！
私、
頑張っちゃうからね♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like we're fixin' to have us some fun!
My prince, my white horse, and li'l old me,
on our very own adventure! Let's go! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
楽しみやね～
王子はんと
白馬はん
そして
マホ姫、
３人の冒険の
始まり始まり～♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And thus the curtain was raised on a perilous journey for {0} and company.
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}たちの珍道中が幕を開けた。
